cases.title: Product photograph
cases.prompt: A studio product photograph centers one upright cream paper coffee bag on a low rectangular slab of pale limestone. The bag has a folded top with two neat side creases, a softly textured matte surface, and a small charcoal rectangular label facing the camera. The label contains exactly two centered lines of lettering: "FIELD NOTES" above "COFFEE", with generous spacing and no other words, numbers, badges, or logos. A single short espresso cup stands at the lower right of the bag, entirely on the same slab, with its small handle pointing right. The cup has a warm gray ceramic glaze and a thin ring of crema visible inside. Five separate roasted coffee beans lie in a loose arc on the slab in front of the bag; none cover the label. The camera looks slightly down from the front, showing the full bag, cup, slab, and their contact shadows without cropping. A large soft light from the upper left creates a long smooth highlight along the bag's left fold and gentle shadows toward the right. The background is an uninterrupted warm off-white studio sweep. Fine paper fibers, small variations in the ceramic glaze, and the porous stone surface remain visible. The composition feels quiet and spacious, with no people, plants, floating objects, additional packages, or decorative lettering.

cases.title: Portrait edit
cases.prompt: The man in the dark shirt seated on the left of <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The woman in the cream sweater seated on the right of <Picture 1> is <Subject 2>. The lettering "MONEY TALKS" on the wooden foreground sign in <Picture 1> is <Subject 3>. The target image shows the same two hosts in the same podcast studio, with bare ears on <Subject 1> and one closed fist from each host meeting gently between the two microphones. <Subject 1> is partially preserved; his facial identity, shirt, seated location, and overall scale remain, while the headphones disappear and one forearm rises toward the center. <Subject 2> is partially preserved; her facial identity, hair, sweater, seated location, and overall scale remain, while one forearm rises to meet his fist. <Subject 3> is fully preserved. Natural hair and visible ears occupy the former headphone area. The two contacting fists are clearly separated from the microphones, and each wrist connects naturally to its own forearm without crossed or duplicated arms. Both hosts retain relaxed expressions directed toward the camera. The wooden sign, mugs, microphones, bookshelves, lamps, visible background lettering, and warm studio lighting remain in their source locations; the gestures leave the foreground sign unobstructed. The scene remains one photograph rather than a collage, and no new text, objects, or people appear.

cases.title: Food textures
cases.prompt: The image is an overhead, top-down photograph of a rustic farm-to-table feast spread across a weathered, dark brown wooden table with visible grain, knots, and a worn finish. In the center, a large woven basket holds a freshly baked rustic loaf of bread with a cracked golden-brown crust and scattered flour, alongside a halved loaf. To the left, a large dark ceramic plate presents an assortment of colorful seasonal vegetables, including bright orange carrots, deep red heirloom tomatoes, purple cabbage, and a mound of vibrant green leafy kale and arugula. On the right side, a wooden board displays artisanal cheeses: a wedge of sharp aged cheddar, a round of creamy brie with a rind, a soft blue cheese, and a few scattered almonds and walnuts. Below the bread in the lower center, a shallow bowl contains roasted root vegetables, including golden potatoes and beets, sprinkled with fresh rosemary sprigs. At the upper right, a glass jar of golden olive oil stands beside a smaller jar of honey with a wooden dipper. In the lower left, a rustic cloth napkin holds a silver knife and fork. At the upper left, a bunch of purple and red grapes rests near a small bowl of black olives. Scattered herbs, including fresh thyme and sprigs of oregano, decorate the table. The lighting is natural and warm, coming from the upper left and casting soft, long shadows to the lower right, enhancing the texture of the bread, the moisture of the vegetables, and the overall cozy, bountiful atmosphere of the meal.

cases.prompt: A finished graphic poster on a warm ivory background combines large charcoal typography with a photographed paper sculpture. The headline occupies the upper third in two clearly separated, left-aligned lines: "MAKE ROOM" followed by "FOR IDEAS". A small line immediately below reads "A creative workshop" in a simple sans-serif typeface. The headline is bold, clean, and fully legible, with no curved baselines or letters hidden behind objects. The lower half contains one sculptural arrangement made from exactly three broad strips of colored paper: a terracotta arch on the left, a muted blue loop at the center, and an ochre folded zigzag on the right. A soft light from the upper left reveals the paper thickness and casts gentle shadows beneath the three forms. Generous empty margins separate the sculpture from the text. The only footer is "Bring your next idea." at the lower left, aligned with the headline. No dates, prices, sponsor names, extra words, ornamental borders, or performance claims appear.

cases.title: Chinese event poster
cases.prompt:
A finished portrait event poster for a fictional independent bookstore's evening arts market. The design combines large, exceptionally legible Simplified Chinese lettering with a warm screen-printed illustration of an open-air courtyard at dusk. Cream paper, deep indigo ink and persimmon orange create a restrained three-color palette. The illustration shows three distinct stalls: an open book display, a small ceramic display and a coffee cart. They sit beneath a string of glowing round lanterns. A few small adult visitors provide scale without covering the lettering. This is the poster artwork itself, with no wall, frame or device around it.

At the top, set the exact headline "把夜晚交给灵感" in very large confident Chinese display type. Immediately below it, a smaller line reads "纸间书店 · 周末创意夜市". Leave generous space around both lines. Beneath the courtyard illustration, put two clear information lines: "2026年11月21日 18:00–22:00" and "河岸路18号 · 入场免费". At the bottom, a tidy three-column schedule pairs each time with its activity. From left to right the columns read "18:30 活字印刷", "19:30 手作陶艺" and "20:30 独立放映". Each time and its activity appear together in the same column. Use crisp Chinese glyphs with complete strokes, aligned baselines and enough contrast for every detail to remain readable. The quoted phrases are the complete poster copy; include each exactly once, with no invented sponsor names, QR codes or filler text.

cases.title: Architectural interior
cases.prompt: An architectural interior photograph shows a quiet contemporary reading room from just inside its entrance, at standing eye level with straight vertical lines. A long oak reading table extends away from the camera through the center of the room. Exactly six matching wooden chairs are arranged around it, three evenly spaced along each long side, with no chairs at either end. The tabletop is mostly clear except for two closed cloth-bound books stacked near its far end; their spines carry no lettering. Floor-to-ceiling bookcases cover the left wall, with narrow vertical uprights and books of varied muted colors. The right wall has three tall rectangular windows separated by pale stone piers. Beyond the windows, soft green tree canopies appear out of focus. Late-afternoon light enters from the right and lays three broad bands of sunlight across the table and the matte stone floor. At the back, a single open doorway reveals a dim adjoining room and establishes depth without adding a second focal point. The exposed oak ceiling beams run consistently from left to right and meet the walls cleanly. Oak grain, linen book covers, finely textured plaster, and subtle wear on chair edges are visible. The room contains no people, screens, signs, decorative plants, warped shelves, or floating furniture.

cases.title: Game environment
cases.prompt:
A single full-frame landscape gameplay-style visual concept for an original third-person exploration game, rendered as detailed real-time 3D game art. The camera is behind and slightly above one adult explorer in the lower-left foreground. The explorer wears a short ochre rain cape, dark trousers and a compact canvas backpack, with both boots planted on a wet stone landing. Their head and body face the distant destination at screen right; one small brass lantern hangs from their right hand. The character occupies about one-fifth of the image height so the environment and route remain easy to read.

A continuous narrow stone bridge begins at the foreground landing, bends through the center of the frame and ends at an open arched doorway on the right side of a ruined observatory. The entire bridge remains visible above calm floodwater, with plausible supports, shallow steps and a low parapet along its outer edge. Warm amber light inside the destination doorway contrasts with cool blue twilight outside. Broken telescope housings, oxidized copper domes and moss-covered masonry make the observatory distinctive. Reeds and floating leaves sit below the bridge, while distant mountains recede into low mist. Water reflects the architecture and doorway light in the correct places. Natural material detail, atmospheric depth and restrained bloom support a believable game environment. The frame contains exactly one human character, no enemies, no HUD, no written text, no logos and no outer monitor or device border.
cases.configuration: SP4 · MXFP8 DiT · resident weights · six steps · seed 42
cases.detail_hint: Weathered stone, metalwork, foliage and water reflections.

presentation: Each scene compares browser-resized versions of one measured 4K image. Left and right output tiers are independent. Aspect ratios are preserved; actual dimensions are labeled. Separate archived generation sizes remain linked, without inventing missing measurements.
source_outputs: Archived API outputs are linked per scene with their measured dimensions and timings. The 1K API output uses a 2K generation canvas before resizing. Missing generated sizes are not inferred from browser resizes.
